title: Start
body:
Lupe’s friend sends him a message about their struggles. It’s deep and dramatic.
What should Lupe do?
[[ A. Lupe will screenshot the message and share it with his closest friend. |option13]]
[[ B. Lupe should keep it private and respond with support and love. |option14]]
[[ C. Lupe must ignore the message. |option15]]
